step_results:
I've fixed the bug in `src/money.js` by using `Math.round()` when converting prices to cents. This prevents floating-point precision errors like `39.95 * 100` becoming `3995.0000000000005` instead of `3995`.

The fix applies to both `parseEuros()` and `cellCents()` functions, so prices like 39.95 now work correctly.

Ready to commit when you approve — I'll include the proper attribution in the commit message.
